column2: My [my_child.GetSonDaughter], [my_child.GetTitledFirstName], has decided to enlist with the Lipka Guard in Riga and seek [my_child.GetHerHis] fortune there! Although [my_child.GetSheHe] will no doubt gain both riches and valuable battle experience in service of the Baltic [baltic_emperor_or_empress.GetEmperorEmpress], there will be many perils that could well cost [my_child.GetHerHim] [my_child.GetHerHis] life.
I will not allow it!
Go to Riga and make me proud, [my_child.GetSonDaughter].

A grizzled old warrior having just returned from the Baltic arrived with a message from [From.GetTitledFirstName] today. Though [From.GetSheHe] has left the Lipka Guard, my [From.GetSonDaughter] has apparently found [From.GetHerselfHimself] a Baltic [From.GetHusbandWifeOpp] and decided to remain by the shores of the Baltic and build a new life there. "It is doubtful we will ever see [From.GetHerHim] again, my [Root.GetLordLady]."
My [From.GetBoyGirl]...

After finishing [From.GetHerHis] service with the Lipka Guard, [From.GetTitledFirstName] has married a local [From.GetManWomanOpp] and decided to remain in Constantinople instead of returning home to the steppe wasteland [From.GetSheHe] once came from. [From.GetSheHeCap] has pledged [From.GetHerHis] continued service to me.
Very well.

A heavily scarred warrior clad in strange armor approaches my throne, and before [From.GetSheHe] can be disarmed, the stranger relieves my guard of their spear in a swift, fluid motion and tosses it aside. Other guards hurry forward, but I raise my hand to stop them. The stranger is [From.GetTitledFirstName], at last returned from the Baltic!
[From.GetFirstName]! You've... changed!

My [From.GetSonDaughter], [From.GetTitledFirstName], has finally returned home from the Baltic and [From.GetHerHis] service with the Lipka Guard! Although I can't quite put my finger on it, [From.GetSheHe] seems different somehow... and what is this strange military camaraderie he speaks of?
No matter, I'm just glad [From.GetSheHe] made it home!

A fat, drunk [From.GetManWoman] is led into my throne room, and the guards explain that [From.GetSheHe] just arrived with a caravan coming from Miklagård. The [From.GetManWoman] would speak my name over and over again while inebriated, and so [From.GetSheHe] was brought to me. To my horror, I recognize [From.GetHerHim] at last as [From.GetTitledFirstName]!
[From.GetFirstName], you disappoint me.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has finally returned home after a long and successful career in the Lipka Guard! [From.GetSheHeCap] fought in several battles, and learned much from the clever strategies and tactics favored by both the lords of the Baltic and their enemies in Europe.
Tell me of your battles, [From.GetFirstName]...

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has returned from the Baltic and the Lipka Guard, but [From.GetSheHe] refuses to speak of [From.GetHerHis] experiences there. I know [From.GetSheHe] took part in several battles and killed many foes, but instead of reveling in the glory of [From.GetHerHis] accomplishments, [From.GetFirstName] is plagued by nightmares and jumps at sudden sounds.
Strange...

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has come home from Riga and [From.GetHerHis] service with the Varangian Guard, but [From.GetSheHe] is not alone. [From.GetSheHeCap] has found a Baltic [From.GetHusbandWifeOpp] and brought [From.GetHerHimOpp] with [From.GetHerHim]. [From.GetSheHeCapOpp] is not familiar with our customs or language, and the climate and the winds do not seem to agree with [From.GetHerHimOpp], but [From.GetSheHeOpp] seems willing to make the best of [From.GetHerHisOpp] new home.
To each their own.

After many years in Riga, [From.GetTitledFirstName] has finally been released from [From.GetHerHis] service to the Lipka Guard and returned home. My child is a changed [From.GetManWoman], however. Allah no longer holds any interest for him, and [From.GetSheHe] instead speaks incessantly of Christendom and the horrors that await those who refuse to convert...
I knew those Balts would be a bad influence.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has returned from Riga and the Lipka Guard a changed [From.GetManWoman]. [From.GetSheHeCap] is wiser, more confident in [From.GetHerHis] own abilities and more knowledgeable in matters of war. It seems the time spent by the Baltic shores did [From.GetHerHim] good.
Welcome home, [From.GetFirstName]!

Several former Lipka Guardsmen have recently returned home after serving the Greek [greek_king_or_queen.GetKingQueen], and they bring news most grave. My [From.GetSonDaughter], [From.GetTitledFirstName], has fallen in battle while campaigning in Europa. They assure me that [From.GetSheHe] faced [From.GetHerHis] enemy with bravery and slew many, before their numbers overwhelmed [From.GetHerHim].
My [From.GetSonDaughter] died a hero...

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has at last returned from the Baltic with a caravan filled with the spoils of war! Apparently the great [greek_king_or_queen.GetKingQueen] of the Greeks is generous to those who serve [baltic_emperor_or_empress.GetHerHim] well, and there is gold here from all over the Baltic realm, Visegrád and beyond. My [From.GetSonDaughter] insists on sharing these riches with me, [From.GetHerHis] loving [Root.GetFatherMother].
[From.GetFirstName], you make me proud!

The death of my [From.GetRootRelation], [From.GetTitledFirstName], has urged me to depart Riga and leave the Lipka guard. I am returning home with a caravan, filled with loot from our campaigns all over the Baltic. After a long and perilous journey back, my feet are now firmly planted on the soil of the land that is my birthright. The throne is mine.
It is as I remember it.
